Hi, The logic blocks b1 to b5 are designed specifically for frequency checking and to activate the function block output when the chosen frequency is reached. You can activate the function block in the instruction tree and view its description by pressing F1. Since you're analyzing frequency, the time base for blocks b1 to b5 is set to 1 second. Hope this clarifies things.
